messages:
alex_support: Customer reports trial credits not decrementing after websocket session resume. Customer says messages go through and model returns, but balance stays the same. Repro steps below.

alex_support: Repro steps from customer:
1) open websocket, send chat for ~100 tokens -> model responds, balance shown in UI unchanged
2) connection drops (mobile network)
3) reconnect using resume_token
4) send follow-up -> model responds, balance still unchanged

alex_support: They included session_id and a tiny transcript. Pasted redacted values below.

sam_engineer: Can you paste session_id / resume_token (redacted) and any proxy/server logs? I'll try to repro locally.

alex_support: session_id: s_9b7f2d (redacted), resume_token: r_abc123 (redacted)

alex_support: Server-side excerpt (redacted):
```
[2026-03-15T12:01:05Z] conn s_9b7f2d reconnected resume_token=r_abc123
[2026-03-15T12:01:07Z] recv message seq=45 input_len=78
[2026-03-15T12:01:08Z] model responded tok_generated=94
[2026-03-15T12:01:08Z] billing finalize not received for seq=45
```

sam_engineer: Hmm — logs show model produced tokens but no finalize event from the WS service. Our WS path normally emits a finalize when the response stream ends; maybe resume flow bypassed that. I'll spin up a local repro with resume.

jess_prod: Billing subsystem returns no debit for that org during the timeframe. Quick query:
```
SELECT * FROM ledger WHERE org_id='acme' AND ts BETWEEN '2026-03-15T12:00' AND '2026-03-15T12:05';
-- returns 0 rows
```

sam_engineer: Working hypothesis: reconnect path creates a new session_id and the finalize hook still points to old session. If resume mapping (resume_token -> active session) isn't persisted prior to finalize, we might drop the finalize. Repro looks possible when client doesn't explicitly send a finalize before disconnect.

sam_engineer: Quick repro notes I'm adding to PR: emulate client that opens WS, sends input, simulates network drop, reconnects with same resume_token, send more input. Observe: model responses but ledger shows no finalize for the first sequence.

sam_engineer: Short-term mitigation idea: treat resume as an implicit finalize of the previous session if there are un-finalized produced tokens older than 10s. Feature-flag gated.

maria_oncall: I'm available to coordinate a canary. We can roll a small patch in eng-runtime behind a flag and watch billing events. Need ops runbook: rollback if we see duplicate debits. Also suggest a manual workaround for affected customers.

jess_prod: Manual workaround: ask customer to call POST /v1/billing/finalize with session_id after reconnect (idempotent). Support to send curl snippet.

alex_support: Sent workaround to customer (they agreed to try finalize call on reconnect and report back tonight). I'll update ticket.

billing_bot: ledger note created: org=acme manual_finalize_requested ticket=2456 requested_by=alex_support

sam_engineer: Opened PR #789: auto-finalize-on-resume, adds unit + integration tests against WS reconnect scenarios. Also added metrics: finalize_missing_count, double_debit_risk.

alex_support: Thanks — marking as escalated. If customer still sees no burn after manual finalize, we'll escalate to oncall and consider issuing temporary credit and full postmortem. :thumbsup:
